This procedure details 
 the testing procedures 
 P1, which recommended to be carried out every six months as indicated by M6 
 in the title block.

The purpose of the relay is 
 basically to give an indication that an inter turn fault occur to earth in the 
 rotor winding or turn-to-turn fault which give alarm only.

The relay contains over 
 current relay set at 0.05 amp, timer operates at one-second-delay time, two 
 capacitors to prevent DC from returning to the relay and path the AC and 
 voltage transformer supplied with 110Vac from the voltage transformer of the 
 rotor winding as the generator operate and 100 v from the testing transformer 
 when the unit off, the other winding of the transformer one terminal is 
 earthed through the rotor brush and the other is connected to the coil of the 
 relay as the fault occur (the circuit is completed through the brush and 
 allowed the current to path to the relay and it operate to give alarm signal.

The first draft initiated by eng. Baha Salah Farag, tested by eng. Badry Atea 
 Rofaiel, 
 accepted by eng. Abdel Azem Gomaa Hagrasy, certified by eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab: UEEPC quality control head sector & MPIS 
 coordinator, and approved by eng. Hussein Ahmed Mahdy: head sector of Assiut 
 Steam PS.

 permit must be issued, the maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety ID category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your Safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, safety belt.... etc

Wear your Safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, safety belt.... etc
The line must be out of service
Isolate the relay from PT`s & CT`s
Test transformer to give the test voltage (100v).

Selector switch to get the 
 test voltage from the test transformer to the relay and isolate the voltage 
 coming from the main unit transformer.

Turn 
 the supply voltage switch from the off position to the auxiliary voltage 
 position.
Insert the special test key into the test selector switch (b6).

Change the position of the test selector switch by the test key on the test 
 panel to the test delay action position.

Press on the test key button 
 until the signal appears.

Release the button of the 
 test key and return the selector back to its first position (action).
Return the supply voltage selector switch back to its off position.
Reset the rotor earth leakage relay to its normal position.
Record the values (results) on the test sheet.
